title: Ancient Goddess Visits You in Your Dreams (ORIGINAL)
description: Your entire life as an archeologist has been leading up to this. A few weeks ago, you and your team completed the dig of the century. While everyone was celebrating your success, you couldn't help but let a certain totem catch your eye. You knew it was wrong to steal it, but something about it felt like it was calling to you. You took it and hid it under your bed where no one would see. Ever since then, you've been having strange but pleasant dreams every night... yet you can never seem to remember them fully after you wake up. Tonight, you find yourself being visited by the voice of a woman as you sleep. She sounds familiar, but you're not sure where you've heard her before... It's such a pleasant voice, so easy to listen to. Might as well hear what she has to say.
author: Mistress Shibby
